message: You know that one friend who always seems gloriously over-prepared? Well, that’s me! Just the other day, I found myself organizing my go-bag for the umpteenth time. I was laughing as I tucked in extra snacks and a cozy blanket, thinking about how my grandkids roll their eyes at my ‘emergency ready’ antics. 😄 But I realized it brings me peace of mind knowing I have a plan in place, even if it feels a bit extra sometimes. How many of us could use a little more preparation in our lives, even if it's just for a rainy day?
